runtime_owner_decision.notes: Required before RFC0004 can move from draft to accepted.

benchmark.notes: Required before native transport implementation markers are allowed; must compare http_json, http2_json_optimized, grpc_json_transcoding, and native_grpc.

build_matrix.notes: Must cover Linux, macOS, and Windows dependency/build impact.

dependency_policy.notes: Must define dependency source, license review, vendoring/cache policy, and local setup impact.

feature_flag.notes: Must define build flag, runtime config, default disabled behavior, and disabled diagnostics.

fallback_semantics.notes: Must define fail-closed behavior and any explicit fallback to grpc_json_transcoding or http_json for unavailable transport, schema mismatch, transport failure, and timeout.

test_strategy.notes: Must cover unit, integration, mock server, capability binding, and release evidence gates.
